description: App-command grants for pack popups (`popup-*`, plan SK2-A5: Xfire's Infoview, StealthX's main menu), each beside the skin window that launched it. The popup renders the served popup shell through the same skin tree as its launcher (`src/windows/SkinPopupWindow.tsx` → `src/components/skin-tree/SkinTreeWindow.tsx`), so it runs its nodes' actions (`run_skin_action`), reports its selection (`set_skin_selection`) and holds what the tree's own parts call: the menu bar a menu popup carries (StealthX's `MainMenuPopup` is the app menu: settings, quit, the help links through `open_external_url`) and the status picker (`set_status`). The event stream and skin read come from `app-baseline.json`, the window chrome from `default.json`. It opens no popups of its own (`open_skin_popup` refuses a popup as launcher). No plugin grants.
